intro: Your LinkedIn banner is the widest piece of real estate on your profile. PiCraft designs one at the exact 1584×396 px size with your name and headline placed where they stay visible.
The left side is kept calm on purpose: that's where your profile photo sits on desktop and mobile.

faq.q: What size is a LinkedIn banner?
faq.a: LinkedIn recommends 1584×396 px, a 4:1 ratio, as a JPG or PNG up to 8 MB. PiCraft exports that exact size plus a 3168×792 px version at twice the size.

faq.q: Why is the text on the right?
faq.a: Your profile photo covers the lower-left part of the banner, so text placed there gets hidden.

faq.q: Does it work for LinkedIn company pages?
faq.a: No. Company pages use a different, wider cover size, so this maker is built for personal profiles. Check LinkedIn's current specifications for the cover size of a Page.

faq.q: Can I leave the text out?
faq.a: The name field is required so the banner has a focal point, but you can enter a short slogan instead of your name.

faq.q: Will my profile photo cover the text?
faq.a: The text is placed in the right half, away from the profile photo. LinkedIn crops the banner differently on mobile, so check your profile on both a phone and a computer after you upload.

faq.q: How long should the headline be?
faq.a: Under 60 characters keeps the text large enough to read. Write a short line about what you do and who you help.

faq.q: Can I use my brand colors?
faq.a: Yes. Type colors such as "navy and teal" in the colors field. For an exact hex code, name the closest color and fine-tune it in an image editor.

faq.q: How do I change my banner on LinkedIn?
faq.a: Open your profile, click the camera icon on the banner, choose Change photo and upload the JPG. Reposition it in the editor if you need to.

faq.q: Does the banner include a photo or logo?
faq.a: No. It is a designed background with your name and headline. Add your photo and logo to your profile separately.
